scope: NBA SGO paired DraftKings points/rebounds/assists; conditional positive-minute participation; baseline-only and paired-context forecasts reported separately
selection: Earliest saved forecast per game/player/market; minutes deduplicate across markets too. Exact ties use identity ascending.
baseline: Saved last-ten same-team projection; saved baseline minutes
purpose: Prospective feasibility and calibration pilot; not a confirmatory promotion trial
samplePolicy: Floors are feasibility targets, not a power calculation or automatic pass. Do not extend or tune this cohort based on results.
decisionPolicy: No production promotion. Final game-cluster uncertainty and calibration review; any confirmatory trial requires a separate predeclared protocol.
sourceChange: 16 event-scoped official NBA adjudications across both providers; player-summed team aggregates; exact Klay team correction and exclusion of misattributed Mason identity with Isaac retained under BALLDONTLIE identity. Previous cohorts remain immutable.
contextPolicy: Missing opponent history leaves candidateProjection null. Never omit quarantined own-team games. Missing loaded summaries block all forecasts.
